metadata.project: Adobe Express Enterprise Integration with ChatGPT Persona Testing
metadata.common_test_task: Create an eagle-themed yellow background asset in Adobe Express using ChatGPT-guided instructions while respecting enterprise brand, privacy, accessibility, and creative workflow expectations.

personas.name: Maya Chen
personas.accessibility_needs: Requires contrast-safe design and alt-text guidance
personas.privacy_posture: Avoids unreleased product claims and customer data

behavior_profile.communication_style: Uses concise bullets, performance language, and platform constraints.
behavior_profile.decision_pattern: Approves concepts that preserve brand colors, legibility, and measurable campaign value.
avoid_list: Do not place text over busy eagle details
acceptance_criteria: Yellow background feels energetic but brand-safe
Eagle is visually dominant without blocking headline space
Asset is ready for social export with review notes

behaviors.title: Campaign-first setup
behaviors.scenario: Starts by asking ChatGPT to define a campaign-ready composition for Adobe Express.
validation_checks: Brand palette is named in the prompt
Design includes a clear social objective

behaviors.title: Engagement review
behaviors.scenario: Checks whether the eagle focal point supports a scroll-stopping social post.
expected_actions: Add review comment for marketing approval

behaviors.title: Publish readiness
behaviors.scenario: Requests final export directions for a campaign asset.
validation_checks: Alt text mentions eagle and yellow background

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Act as my Adobe Express Enterprise design assistant. I am Maya, an advanced social media manager who wants concise, campaign-ready guidance. Use Conversational Design Creation to build a square social background with a bold eagle as the hero and a warm yellow brand-safe gradient. Apply Enterprise Brand Control before suggesting colors, then use AI-Powered Editing to improve contrast and keep empty headline space. Do not invent metrics, mention competitors, or place text on busy feathers. Add Collaboration and Review notes for brand approval, include an accessibility contrast check, and finish with Export and Publish steps for PNG plus an editable Adobe Express file.

personas.isolated_test_prompt: You are assisting Rafael, a compliance-focused brand director, inside Adobe Express Enterprise. Use Enterprise Brand Control and Shared Libraries first: create a yellow eagle background only from approved assets or clearly labeled AI-generated elements. Explain each design choice formally, then use Security and Compliance checks to confirm no confidential data, external logos, or legal claims are present. Add Version History notes that describe every AI-assisted change, route the file through Collaboration and Review, and prepare export instructions only after approval is recorded.

behaviors.title: Trainer-friendly export

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Please guide Aisha through Adobe Express like a training coach. Use Text to Template and Conversational Design Creation to make a reusable course-slide background: yellow background, centered eagle image, calm open space for a module title, and a simple visual hierarchy. Give numbered steps for adding the image, checking the colour, and adjusting the eagle size. Use Accessibility Checks for contrast, font size, and alt text. Avoid employee names, internal records, clutter, and intimidating language. End with Quick Actions and Export and Publish instructions for a PNG and reusable template.

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Help Noah explore a yellow eagle background in Adobe Express without overcomplicating it. Start with AI-Powered Editing and Generative Fill to create exactly three variations: bold sunrise yellow, clean corporate yellow, and dramatic golden spotlight. If I add an eagle image, use Remove Background and refine the edges before placing it. Suggest one tasteful Text Effects treatment only if it improves the design. Keep layers editable, name each option in Version History, remind me not to upload restricted client assets, and recommend the strongest final version with a short reason.

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Support Priya with a polished, executive-safe Adobe Express workflow. Use Conversational Design Creation to make one refined yellow eagle background suitable for a leadership slide or announcement. Keep the eagle elegant, leave large clear space for a headline, and apply Enterprise Brand Control so the yellow is approved. Use Quick Actions only for simple edits such as crop, resize, and image cleanup. Avoid casual wording, executive names, speculative claims, or confidential board details. Add a Security and Compliance check and send the design through Collaboration and Review before export.

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Assist Lena in Adobe Express Enterprise with a localization-safe eagle background. Use Text to Template and Localization Support to build a yellow eagle design that keeps all text editable and leaves extra room for longer German and French copy. Apply Enterprise Brand Control so the yellow and typography remain consistent across markets. Do not use idioms, hard-coded English text, or launch-market details. Create Version History names with locale codes such as master-en, de-DE, and fr-FR, then provide Export and Publish instructions for an editable master plus localized PNG variants.

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Operate under Marcus's IT security rules for Adobe Express Enterprise. Before creating anything, state that no secrets, personal data, unreleased files, or public share links may be used. Build a yellow eagle background only with Shared Libraries or clearly identified generated elements. Use Security and Compliance to check data boundaries, Enterprise Brand Control for approved colors, and Version History to log each AI-assisted edit. Route Collaboration and Review only to restricted internal reviewers, then summarize the audit trail before any export guidance.

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Help Sofia produce a high-energy Adobe Express event background. Use Quick Actions and AI-Powered Editing to create a dramatic yellow eagle visual that works on a widescreen event display and can be cropped for social. Make the eagle powerful but leave a clean center-safe area for event text. Use one tasteful Text Effects option for a headline only if contrast remains strong on a large screen. Do not add attendee data, unapproved sponsor logos, or low-contrast overlays. Finish with Collaboration and Review approval steps and Export and Publish outputs for widescreen plus social crop.

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Follow Ethan's accessibility QA approach in Adobe Express. Create a yellow eagle background using AI-Powered Editing, but design it around Accessibility Checks from the start. Keep any future text area separate from the eagle image, do not rely on color alone, and use Remove Background if the eagle creates visual clutter. Provide a pass/fail checklist for contrast, readability, alt text, and decorative versus meaningful image use. If anything fails, give remediation steps before export. Use Collaboration and Review for QA notes and Export and Publish only after checks pass.

personas.isolated_test_prompt: Work with Hana as a fast, mobile-first Adobe Express design partner. Use Conversational Design Creation and Generative Fill to create a vertical yellow eagle background for a launch teaser, with the eagle clearly visible in a mobile crop and space for a short headline. Keep it bold, minimal, and growth-test friendly. Use one Text Effects zone if it improves the hook, then use Quick Actions to resize for mobile placements. Do not mention investors, roadmap features, or private launch details. Finish with Export and Publish instructions for mobile PNG, editable source, and A/B test names.
